approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Myrbetriq (mirabegron), 25 mg and 50 mg, for the treatment of overactive bladder. (FDA approval letter, NDA 202611, signed 06/28/2012)

series_start_reason: Astellas' financial-results library on astellas.com begins with Q1 FY2017 (April-June 2017). The Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 FY2017 financial results releases (and their supplementary documents) print the FY2016 comparatives (April-June, April-September, April-December and full-year FY2016), so FY2016 Q1-Q4 (calendar 2016Q2-2017Q1) are taken from them: the first quarter as printed, the others as year-to-date or annual differences. Nothing before April 2016 is printed as a quarter in any Astellas document located: the FY2016 and earlier results documents are not on astellas.com (every guessed legacy URL returned 404) and the FY2015 integrated report prints annual figures only.
notes: Printed label is 'Betanis/Myrbetriq/BETMIGA' (Japan, U.S., Europe brand names of mirabegron on one global line; spelled 'Betanis/Myrabetriq/BETMIGA' in some FY2018-FY2019 supplementary documents). Row is in the 'Global' sales-of-major-products table (billions of JPY).
search_log: read https://www.astellas.com/en/investors/financial-results-library (146 PDF links) and cached every financial-results PDF (main release, supplementary documents, presentation, earnings-call scripts); earliest linked quarter is Q1 FY2017 (April-June 2017)
guessed legacy astellas.com/en/ir/library/pdf/... URLs for FY2013-FY2016 documents: all returned 404, so no earlier Astellas document was found
extracted the 'Global' sales-of-major-products table in each quarter's supplementary document (billions of JPY, one decimal) with pdfplumber, the verifier's extractor

where the quarter's own document text layer splits the digits of the row, the same quarter was read from a later document of the same fiscal year, or derived from year-to-date figures (rows are labelled accordingly)
cross-check: for every complete fiscal year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year figure on the same table (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)

FY2017 Q1-Q4 supplementary documents (supplementary-documents-q1-2017.pdf to -q4-2017.pdf) read with pdfplumber: the 'Global' sales-of-major-products table prints FY2016 comparatives as April-June, April-September, April-December and full year, so FY2016 quarters 1-4 were added as 2016Q2 (printed), 2016Q3 and 2016Q4 (year-to-date differences) and 2017Q1 (full year less nine months)

FY2015 integrated report (about-astellas-integrated-report-2016.pdf, 158 pages) searched line by line for the product with Q1-Q4 or quarter markers: no quarterly lines, annual only; astellas.com paths for FY2016 releases (supplementary-documents-q1..q4-2016.pdf, financial-results-q*-2016.pdf, 1q2016_sup_en.pdf and similar under documents/financial-results and en/ir/library/pdf) returned 404; web.archive.org is blocked from this environment
cross-check: the four FY2016 quarters sum to the full-year FY2016 figure printed in the same table (differences nil at one decimal)
